semantics: Batching is only an inference/throughput optimization across independent exact hands or independent common states.
Every hand keeps its own authoritative C++ state, scenario, deck seed, candidate seat, action ordinal, legal exact-action set and keyed common-random-number draw.
No game state is merged, abstracted further, translated, dropped, resampled or given a different random draw because of batching.
Policies are evaluated with the same finalized AveragePolicy weights and the same state-local deduplicated ten-action legality mask.
The official evaluator uses the fixed batch size above; evaluation sample counts frozen in R7.5.4 are unchanged.
Dense-reference cache reuse remains exact: the same baseline terminal result is reused, not approximated.
R7.5.4A-160 remains prune-only and cannot authorize production training or table use.
